name: pit-stop
description: Self-hosted team retrospectives: live anonymous sticky-note boards, grouping, votes and actions carried over to the next retro.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix service install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n service,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix service run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix service run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix service test && npm --prefix web test
